# Pixel Pomodoro Timer

A minimal, offline pixel-art themed Pomodoro timer built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Features

- 25-minute work mode and 5-minute break mode
- Start / Pause / Reset controls
- Large countdown display
- Keyboard-accessible labeled buttons with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- No external assets, imports, or network requests

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Use the mode buttons to switch between Work (25 min) and Break (5 min). Press Start to begin the countdown, Pause to stop temporarily, and Reset to restore the full duration for the current mode.

When the countdown reaches zero, the timer automatically switches to the other mode.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure and required IDs/text
- `styles.css` – pixel-art palette, layout, and interactive states
- `script.js` – timestamp-based timer logic and event wiring

## Accessibility

All controls are native buttons with accessible labels. Focus is clearly visible via `:focus-visible` outlines. The countdown and mode indicator use `aria-live` for screen reader announcements.
